* One logical operation is one business request. Retries are attempts, not extra incidents or requests. A terminal failure means the final attempt/outcome has a failure code whose `is_success` is 0; an earlier failed attempt followed by success is not a terminal failure.   SELECT o.operation_id, o.route_id, o.opened_at_ms,

),
att AS (
  SELECT asg.*, e.attempt_no, e.attempt_id, fc.is_success, p.deadline_ms,

    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY asg.operation_id) n_att
  FROM asg JOIN attempt_events e ON e.operation_id=asg.operation_id
  JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=e.code_id

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN n_att>1 THEN operation_id END) retried_ops,
  MIN(deadline_ms) min_dl, MAX(deadline_ms) max_dl
FROM att GROUP BY period, pool_id ORDER BY period, pool_id;
